summary: NISCH-013 Live Activity Class Chip E2E Verification Complete. All 42 tests passed (19 E2E + 14 unit + 9 swallow_audit). Backend: GET /api/operator/command-center/{user_id} now includes motion_telemetry slot with status bands (live/fresh/recent/stale/unavailable), activity_class, freshness_s, activity_distribution_24h, and telemetry_pipeline_version. Frontend: LiveActivityChip.jsx component renders in user-context-bar with correct data-testid attributes. Swallow audit ratchet held: unresolved_debt=1.

integration_issues.issue: Intermittent slow loading - page sometimes stays in skeleton state for extended periods. Pre-existing condition, not related to NISCH-013.

critical_code_review_comments: NISCH-013 command_center_unified.py: _build_motion_telemetry_view helper is read-only (SELECT only), fail-silent on errors (returns status='unavailable'), and correctly wired into unified envelope at step 9.

NISCH-013 LiveActivityChip.jsx: Component correctly implements all data-testid attributes (live-activity-chip, live-activity-chip-dot, live-activity-chip-label, live-activity-chip-relative, live-activity-chip-loading). Ambient design with no pulsing animations.
NISCH-013 Band alignment: _MOTION_RECENT_S (1800s) == MOTION_FRESHNESS_MEDIUM_RED_S in trust.py - locked invariant verified.
NISCH-013 Freshness bands: LIVE ≤60s, FRESH ≤5m, RECENT ≤30m, STALE >30m - all verified.
Swallow audit ratchet held: idempotency_race=1, compensating_action_exists=41, unresolved_debt=1.

success_rate.frontend: Component verified via API response and code review. UI intermittently loads due to pre-existing Command Center loading issue.

seed_data_creation: Motion features rows created during E2E testing (test data with unique device_ids and timestamps).
